command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '@@ BOOT_START'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo '@@ TIME_START'
date -u +%s
cat /proc/uptime
echo '@@ PROVIDER_HASH'
sha256sum /lib/modules/5.4.261/kernel/tztv-battery.ko
n=0
for d in /sys/bus/platform/drivers/tztv-battery/*linker*; do
  [ -d "$d" ] || continue
  n=$((n+1))
  [ "$n" -le 4 ] || exit 66
  echo "@@ DEVICE $d"
  readlink -f "$d"
  module=$(readlink -f "$d/driver/module")
  echo "@@ MODULE $module"
  [ "$module" = /sys/module/tztv_battery ] || exit 67
  compatible=$(base64 < "$d/of_node/compatible")
  echo "@@ COMPATIBLE $compatible"
  [ "$compatible" = c2Ftc3VuZyx0enR2LWxpbmtlcgA= ] || exit 68
  ls -ld "$d/production_mode/panel_production"
  echo '@@ CACHED_PANEL_PRODUCTION'
  head -c 64 "$d/production_mode/panel_production"
  echo
  echo '@@ END_DEVICE'
done
echo "@@ DEVICES $n"
echo '@@ BOOT_END'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo '@@ TIME_END'
date -u +%s
cat /proc/uptime
purpose: Finite read of cached production_mode/panel_production sysfs show; exact copied show routine is one cached field load +snprintf. Verify module and DT compatible binding; no hardware getter/control/GPIO/MMIO/trace.
